title: Sahara Desert sand “Chitligsan”: characterisation and assessment of antibacterial activity and cytotoxicity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3395-3408
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04969E, Paper

Gamze Ertunc, Ebru Yilmaz, Dilan Celebi-Birand, Busra Kilic, Seyma Nigiz, Evren Cubukcu, Ceren Ozkul, Halil Murat Aydin, Memed Duman
Chitligsan is a Sahara-derived biopolymer nanomaterial enriched with metal oxides. Analytical characterization confirmed its composition, while assays showed low cytotoxicity, scratch closure and antibacterial activity.
